verdict.rationale: Martin's docs describe connectable calendar and inbox integrations: it can read, create, and update calendar events and read, draft, and reply to emails once connected, plus a Slack integration. Nothing in the evidence shows a cloud-drive connector (Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, etc.), and nothing explicitly shows the assistant searching across connected sources to ground its answers. Missing for 10: cloud drive connector, documented search over connected email/calendar content for answers, setup/permission detail, independent hands-on corroboration.
